pushwoosh_message_sent_trigger.description: Runs when a message finishes sending, with its sends, deliveries and opens so far.

output.message: The record returned by the service

pushwoosh_new_application_trigger.description: Runs when an application (project) is created on the account.

output.application: The record returned by the service

pushwoosh_new_campaign_trigger.description: Runs when a campaign is created in the application.

output.campaign: The record returned by the service

pushwoosh_new_message_trigger.description: Runs when a message is created in the application, from the API, the Control Panel or a journey.

output.message: The record returned by the service

pushwoosh_new_segment_trigger.description: Runs when a segment is created in the application.

output.segment: The record returned by the service

pushwoosh_new_tag_trigger.description: Runs when a tag is created on the account.

output.tag: The record returned by the service
